card.thesis: Round 48 cell on the taxable trading book: base `arot` (`A-rotation`, the card seated on `app.paperdesk.desk.AGENT_IDS` today), read verbatim from `backend/app/paper/library/candidates/A-rotation.json` -- entry 'close > sma(50) and rsi(14) > 55 and rsi(14) < 80', exit 'close < sma(50) or rsi(14) < 45', stop 0.12, take-profit 0.20, hold cap 120, 3 slots at 0.30 each. This is the BASE cell: the seated card unchanged except for its identifying fields. Its sibling risk1pct cell changes exactly one thing against it, per PROTOCOL.md section 7's one-decision rule. Pre-registered 2026-09-09, before any measurement (see strategy-program/ROUND-48-PLAN.md). Nothing here is promotable -- the `trading` purpose is exempt from PROTOCOL.md section 6 promotion (r21 amendment); this is a measurement study, report only, and a decision to resize a seated card for real is the owner's, about risk, not this round's to make. Not investment advice.
card.falsification: Baseline against which this base's risk1pct cell is contrasted. Decision rule (ROUND-48-PLAN.md section 4): risk1pct earns something only if its marginal -- the mean over the five bases of (risk1pct median adjusted excess minus that base's own median) -- exceeds the 21.2pp floor AND every risk1pct cell survives BH q<0.10 over m=10 (base cells carry p=None but still occupy a seat in m). Pre-registered predictions: (1) null on the median marginal (|marginal| < 5pp). (2) worst window shallower on at least 4 of 5 bases. (3) IQR narrower on at least 4 of 5. (4) mean exposure lower on 5 of 5. (5) per-window sign pattern identical on at least 7 of 8 windows for every base. (6) adjusted excess per unit exposure within +/-3pp of the base on every base -- sizing is not alpha. (7) `i13f` cells unranked by provenance on the main windows, reported not interpreted. (8) PROTOCOL.md section 4's caveat applies: a smaller book's shallower worst window is a size effect, and the report prints the worst window in dollars of realised P&L per cell so that effect is visible in currency, not only in percentage points. Nothing here is promotable regardless of outcome (`trading` purpose, PROTOCOL.md r21 amendment).
